messages:
harper: Quick thread  outage outreach draft for ~18 customers impacted by delayed document ingestion (2026-04-14 09:40 UTC -> 2026-04-14 12:10 UTC). Planning a small pilot to 3 accounts. Draft below.

joni: Thanks. Can we confirm no PII exposure and no permanent data loss? Need a line to reassure customers.

leo: Ops confirms no PII affected and replay completed for most batches; a small subset is being reprocessed.

ara: Recommend offering a one-time goodwill credit (1 day) and an optional verification call for customers with active renewals. Flag renewals if they push back.

finn-legal: Ok with neutral phrasing like "intermittent ingestion delays". Cap credits at 1 day or 7% of monthly bill, whichever is smaller. Avoid causal language.

harper: Draft (pilot send 13:00 PT):

"Hi [Name],

Were reaching out to let you know we experienced intermittent ingestion delays that may have affected recent document uploads for your account between 2026-04-14 09:40 UTC and 2026-04-14 12:10 UTC. Our engineers have implemented mitigations and are reprocessing affected batches.

What were doing:
 Enabling targeted re-ingestion for impacted uploads.
 Running verification checks and will share completion status.
 Offering a one-time goodwill credit equivalent to 1 day of service usage and an optional verification call.

If youd like us to prioritize your tenant for reprocessing or schedule a verification call, reply to this message and well set it up.

Thanks for your patience,
Harper, Customer Success"

joni: Pilot to 3 high-touch accounts sounds good. I'll prepare the pilot list and DM the CS reps.

leo: I'll post verification links when reprocessing completes. ETA ~2h.

harper: Pilot 13:00 PT, full send 16:00 PT pending pilot. Action owners: harper  send outbound; joni  pilot list + DM; leo  verification links; ara  renewals escalation.

cs-bot: Pilot send scheduled for 2026-04-14 13:00 PT. Calendar invite created for verification calls (invite id: vfy-4455).

harper: Thanks team  escalate any replies requesting > offered credit to me and finn-legal for review. Ill compile replies and surface renewal risk.
